title: Law, Ethics, Language & Civilization
subtitle: A Unified Geometric, Thermodynamic & Institutional Framework

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Law, Ethics, Language & Civilization” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.caption: Figure 3.1 — Law, Ethics, Language & Civilization.
blocks.explanation: The social space is treated as a multi-agent coupled manifold where unconstrained free-energy minimization in one agent causes chaotic divergence in another. Four macro-structural boundary conditions regulate it: law as an explicit topological constraint matrix, peace as low-entropy homeostasis, ethics as an internalized coordinate metric, and privacy as maintenance of the Markov-blanket boundary. Language is the shared syntactic coordinate system that binds isolated minds into a collective hyper-manifold. Institutional taxonomies — ISCED (education/input), ISCO-ILO (labour/agency), ISIC (industry/transformation) — form the orthogonal axes of the global socio-economic manifold.
blocks.tts: Law, ethics, language, and civilization as the boundary conditions and coordinate systems of a coupled social manifold minimizing collective free energy.
